policy: Named bean/pea species or market classes are separate canonical rows next to the untouched generic 'beans' and 'peas' rows. Cultivar-shade, size-grade and alternate-name variants are NOT rows: they are collapsed by the rule's 'canonical' table and listed as synonym CANDIDATES (synonyms.csv is not touched in this workstream).
